'''Kestrel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] cadet that attended the [[Imperial Naval Academy (Coruscant)|Coruscant Naval Academy]]. He and [[Flinn]] were assigned by [[Maggis]] to monitor the newly arrived [[Lune Oddo Divinian]]. When [[Trever Flume]] arrived at the Academy under the alias of [[Trever Flume|Fortin]], Kestrel berated him for not wearing his hat as per regulations. In a flight class, the students were assigned to combat each other two by two. Lune and Trever managed to beat them and Kestrel was one of the considerations for the next Imperial project before it was turned to Lune. However, Kestrel witnessed Maggis' betrayal and tried to activate the security system, but Maggis, Trever, and Lune already escaped.
